id: title:frankh:install rustls cryptoprovider in capture apm metrics

review.posthog_relevance: Adds TLS support and initialization for Redis/Valkey connections in the capture service, potentially preventing TLS handshake failures and task panics.
review.reason: Adds rustls dependency and AWS LC-RS initialization for TLS connections to Redis/Valkey. P1.F2.H1 adds the crate; P1.F3.H1 adds runtime initialization. This could prevent TLS handshake failures and subsequent task panics when connecting to Valkey, improving reliability of the capture service.
review.uncertainty: The comment suggests the change prevents panics, but no test or failure reproduction is shown. The benefit is inferred rather than demonstrated. No score.

observations.limitations: This chunk is dominated by Cargo.lock and Cargo.toml dependency additions. P1.F1.H1 adds a dependency, P1.F2.H1 adds a conditional dependency, P1.F3.H1 adds a runtime initialization. No implementation or behavior change is shown. No score.

observations.posthog_connection: Adds the rustls crate to the capture-apm-metrics binary, which is required for TLS connections to Redis/Valkey. The comment suggests this is needed for rediss:// connections.

observations.behavior: Adds runtime initialization of the AWS LC-RS crypto provider for rustls.
observations.code_quote: // Without this, the first TLS handshake to Valkey panics the task that made it.
observations.posthog_connection: This change could prevent TLS handshake failures and subsequent task panics when connecting to Valkey, potentially improving reliability of the capture service.
